title: Polynomial-Time Completion Recognition
statement: The function on bit strings that returns $[1]$ exactly when the input is empty or consists of the single bit $0$, and returns $[0]$ otherwise, is polynomial-time computable. A deterministic Turing machine with finitely many states computes it on every input of length $n$ within $C(n+1)^c$ steps for some $C,c\in\mathbb{N}$.
